Code + Standard Coverage — ASME, API, ISO

3D scanning supports inspection workflow against ASME B&PV Section V Article 23 (UT thickness mapping cross-referenced to scan geometry), Section VIII Div 1 (vessel geometry recomputation for FFS), B31.3 (process piping); API 510 §5 (vessel inspection), API 570 §5 (piping inspection), API 653 §6 (tank inspection with Annex B settlement contour), API RP 583 (CUI strategy with scan-identified high-risk zones), API 579-1 Part 5 (LTA with scan-derived critical-thickness profile), Part 8 (shell distortion with scan-derived geometric deviation against perfect cylindrical). ISO 15926 reference-data alignment for handoff to AVEVA PI + Bentley iTwin + Cognite Data Fusion. See Digital Twins, API 579 FFS, RBI.

Damage-Mechanism Mapping per API RP 571 — Oman Service Specifics

Sour-service piping per NACE MR0175 / ISO 15156 on PDO upstream + OQ gas; sulfidation §4.4.2 on Sohar refining; HTHA §5.1.3.1 on hydroprocessing; amine cracking §5.1.2.3 + NACE SP0472 PWHT on gas-treatment; CUI §4.3.5 on Sohar + Mina Al-Fahal coastal salt-laden air per API RP 583; chloride SCC §4.5.1 on austenitic stainless cooling; MIC §5.1.1.6 on stagnant seawater + Sohar harbour; HIC/SOHIC §5.1.2.4 on sour vessels. 3D scanning flags geometry deviations (bulges, dish, distortion) that correlate with these mechanisms — feeding FFS Part 5 LTA + Part 8 distortion + Part 9 crack-like assessments.
